PASSES-BEACH: Spanish mackerel, jacks, sharks (lemon, blacktip), cobia, pompano, sheepshead, snook at Boca Grande / Stump Pass / Englewood Beach / Manasota; live shrimp, whitebait, spoons. LEMON BAY: trout, redfish, snook along ICW and mangroves. NEARSHORE: bonita, cobia, mackerel, tripletail, snappers on structure / light seas. Baits: live shrimp, pilchards, soft plastics, paddletails, fiddler crabs. Sources: local charters Nov 24-25 (sharks, mackerel, redfish), Fishin Franks / FL Sportsman recent.
